declaration.title: Seller declaration
declaration.text: I declare that all information and photos in this ad are true and current, that I own the property or am authorised by its owner to advertise it, and that I have the right to publish these photos. I alone am fully responsible for the ad's content and any dealings that result from it. I understand that the platform accepting the ad for publication is only a check against its posting policy, and does not mean it has verified the ad's details, my ownership or my capacity.
declaration.label: I have read and accept the seller declaration
declaration.required: You must accept the seller declaration before submitting.

security.title: Two-step login
security.intro: Once it is on, signing in also asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator). It is required for administrators on the live site.
security.adminRequired: The admin dashboard requires two-step login. Turn it on or enter your code to continue.
security.enrolIntro: Two-step login isn't on for your account yet.
security.scan: Open your authenticator app, scan this code, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.qrAlt: QR code to add this account to your authenticator app
security.manualKey: Or enter this key by hand
security.challenge: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
security.codeWrong: The code is wrong or has expired. Try the current one.
security.active: Two-step login is on for this account.
security.removeConfirm: Turn off two-step login? Without it you can't open the admin dashboard on the live site.
security.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
